questions.title: What is the first essential step in solving any radical equation?
choices: Square both sides of the equation immediately
Isolate the radical term on one side of the equation
Factor the expressions inside the radicand
Multiply the entire equation by the index of the radical
questions.explain: To solve a radical equation, you must first isolate the radical expression on one side of the equation before applying any powers to eliminate the root.

questions.title: Solve the radical equation: x-3=5
questions.explain: First, square both sides to eliminate the radical: (x-3)2=52⇒x-3=25. Adding 3 to both sides yields x=28. Checking: 28-3=25=5.

questions.title: Why can extraneous solutions occur when solving radical equations?
choices: Because of rounding decimals to integers
Because squaring or raising both sides of an equation to an even power can introduce false solutions
Because odd roots are undefined for negative numbers in the real number system
Because radical equations always result in imaginary coordinates
questions.explain: Raising an equation to an even power eliminates the negative sign (since both positive and negative values yield positive results when squared). This creates a derived equation with more potential solutions than the original.

questions.title: Solve the equation x=x+6 and identify any extraneous solutions.
choices: x=3 is valid; x=-2 is extraneous
x=-2 is valid; x=3 is extraneous
Both x=3 and x=-2 are valid solutions
There are no real solutions to this equation
questions.explain: Squaring both sides gives x2=x+6⇒x2-x-6=0⇒(x-3)(x+2)=0</. Testing x=3 yields 3=9 (valid). Testing x=-2 yields -2=4 (false, since the principal square root of 4 is positive 2), making -2 extraneous.

questions.title: Solve the equation containing two radicals: 3x-5-x+3=0
questions.explain: Isolate the radicals: 3x-5=x+3. Square both sides: 3x-5=x+3. Subtract x and add 5 to both sides: 2x=8⇒x=4. Checking: 7-7=0.

questions.title: Solve the multi-step radical equation: 2x+5-4=6
questions.explain: First, isolate the radical: 2x+5=10⇒x+5=5. Square both sides: x+5=25. Solving for x gives x=20. Checking: 225-4=10-4=6.

questions.title: Solve the rational exponent equation: (x-1)32=8
questions.explain: Raise both sides to the reciprocal power of 23: x-1=823. Since 823=(83)2=22=4, we have x-1=4⇒x=5.

questions.title: Solve the equation: 2x+1=x-7. Identify valid and extraneous solutions.
choices: x=4 and x=12 are both valid solutions
x=4 is valid; x=12 is an extraneous solution
x=12 is valid; x=4 is an extraneous solution
This equation has no real solutions
questions.explain: Square both sides: 2x+1=(x-7)2⇒2x+1=x2-14x+49⇒x2-16x+48=0⇒(x-12)(x-4)=0</. Check x=12: 25=5 (valid). Check x=4: 9=4-7⇒3=-3 (false, so x=4 is extraneous).

questions.title: Determine the solution set for the equation: x+3=-4 in the real number system.
questions.explain: In the real number system, a principal square root u is defined to be non-negative. Therefore, x+3 can never equal a negative number like -4.

questions.title: Solve the cubic radical equation: 2x-53=3
questions.explain: Cube both sides to eliminate the cube root: (2x-53)3=33⇒2x-5=27. Add 5 to both sides: 2x=32. Divide by 2: x=16. Checking: 32-53=3.
